name: Orthographic Multi-View Voxelization
definition: Rasterizes scene geometry into a 3D texture using three orthographic cameras aligned with the scene's bounding box axes to create a voxelized representation for subsequent volume rendering.
summary: Orthographic Multi-View Voxelization rasterizes geometry into a 3D texture using three orthogonal cameras, differing from single-view methods by ensuring complete coverage and from 3-pass methods by using sheet buffers for efficient GPU encoding.
